body_lead: Maharashtra To Get New Private University With Courses In AI, Law, Architecture And More The upcoming permanent campus at Dronagiri, spread across 410 acres, is envisioned as a world-class hub for education and research. Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) Chairman and Managing Director Mukesh Ambani on Friday announced plans to establish a new state private university in Maharashtra aimed at meeting global academic standards.
